FILES: rich/table.py:448-451
ROOT CAUSE: In `Table.add_row`, when new columns are automatically created because the number of provided renderables exceeds the current number of columns, these new `Column` instances use the default `highlight=False` instead of inheriting `Table.highlight`.
CHANGE: Modify the `Column` instantiation in `Table.add_row` to set `highlight=self.highlight`.
TEST: tests/test_table.py

I fixed the issue in `rich/table.py` within the `Table.add_row` method. When columns are automatically created because the number of renderables exceeds the current number of columns, the new `Column` instances now inherit the `highlight` value from the `Table` instance (`highlight=self.highlight`) instead of using the default `False`.

To verify the fix, run:
`pytest tests/test_table.py`
